in_sanskrit.name: Mustufa
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है One who is steadfast and unyielding
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mustufa एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mustufa is a powerful and strong name derived from the Sanskrit word 'mithra', meaning friend. The name signifies one who is steadfast and unyielding, and is a symbol of loyalty and trustworthiness. It is believed that those named Mustufa possess a strong sense of duty and are natural leaders.
